Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Monday
Markets.summary: Indian equities fell over 2% last week due to rising crude oil prices, foreign institutional investor outflows, and geopolitical tensions. Broader markets underperformed as global indices declined and market sentiment favored bears.

Markets.title: Peter Lynch on stock picking: 'You shouldn't own a stock if you can't…'
Markets.summary: Legendary investor Peter Lynch advises that people should thoroughly understand a company's business fundamentals, growth prospects, and financials before buying its stock. He stresses that investors should research these factors rather than relying on popularity or hearsay.

Markets.title: Mcap of 8 of top-10 firms erodes by Rs 1.55 lakh cr; HDFC Bank, Bajaj Fin biggest laggards
Markets.summary: Eight of India's top ten firms lost Rs 1.55 lakh crore in market valuation amid a broader market downturn. The BSE Sensex fell by 1,605.44 points, with HDFC Bank and Bajaj Finance suffering the largest losses.

Markets.title: F&O Talk: Nifty plunged 2% this week. Are charts indicating a deeper sell-off?
Markets.summary: SBI Securities analyst Sudeep Shah expects further weakness in Indian equities due to negative FII positioning, rising volatility, and technical indicators. While flagging IT as a relatively stronger sector, he has identified key support and resistance levels for the Nifty following its two percent weekly drop.

Markets.title: Warren Buffett’s 6 golden rules for investors after retirement
Markets.summary: Warren Buffett's retirement advice includes using low-cost index funds, paying off high-interest debt, and keeping cash reserves. His strategy also emphasizes staying within one's circle of competence and living frugally to manage risk and build wealth.

Markets.title: 11 Penny stocks surged up to 180% in 3 months. Do you own any?
Markets.summary: Eleven low-priced stocks with market caps under Rs 1,000 crore and share prices below Rs 20 surged by up to 181% over a three-month period. Kapil Raj Finance and Tuni Textile Mills led the gains among these companies, according to ACE Equity data.

Geo-Political.title: More than 1,300 arrested as clashes follow another day of mass protests across France
Geo-Political.summary: Over 1,300 people were arrested in France following violent clashes during another wave of mass protests. Hundreds of thousands of demonstrators participated in these events, which also spread to other European nations.

Geo-Political.title: Israel to close West Bank crossings on election day as crackdown escalates
Geo-Political.summary: The Israeli Defense Forces are closing West Bank crossings and restricting Palestinian workers ahead of Tuesday's election. This action is part of an escalating crackdown on the region.

Geo-Political.title: Voters in Brazil head to polls as Lula goes up against Bolsonaro's son
Geo-Political.summary: Voters in Brazil are participating in an election where incumbent leader Lula is running for a fourth term. Flávio Bolsonaro, the son of the imprisoned former president, is challenging Lula in this race.

Geo-Political.title: Musk says SpaceX restricted Ukraine's Starlink connection as service restored
Geo-Political.summary: Elon Musk stated that SpaceX limited Ukraine's access to Starlink because the country allegedly violated terms of service by using the network for military operations. Meanwhile, the satellite internet service has now been restored.

Geo-Political.title: Gunmen kill at least 10 villagers and loot shops in north-east Nigeria
Geo-Political.summary: Gunmen killed at least ten villagers and looted shops in north-east Nigeria. Police are searching for additional casualties as officials warn the death toll may rise.

Geo-Political.title: Man arrested after fire at Hitler's mountaintop Eagle's Nest retreat
Geo-Political.summary: A man has been arrested following a fire at Adolf Hitler's former Eagle's Nest mountain retreat in Germany. Approximately 200 emergency personnel responded to extinguish the blaze at the historic Alpine residence.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator recently discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This experiment highlights a shift in organic traffic strategies from traditional SEO to AI optimization (AIO).

AI & Tech.summary: This article highlights ten essential artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These technologies help digital creators streamline their workflows and stay ahead of industry advancements.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transformed from a file-sharing service into a generative AI platform for content creation. The updated tool allows creators to generate, share, and monetize their artificial intelligence content.

Data & Insights.title: Centre extends AIF scheme to boost farm infrastructure investments
Data & Insights.summary: The government has extended the Agriculture Infrastructure Fund until March 31, 2027. The scheme provides subsidized loans and credit guarantees to build facilities like warehouses and cold storages to reduce crop losses.

Data & Insights.title: The week ahead in numbers: Govt’s H1 fiscal data, factory output, HUL Q2 earnings
Data & Insights.summary: The upcoming week features key economic events, including the Indian government's first-half fiscal data and factory output figures. Additionally, Hindustan Unilever (HUL) is scheduled to release its second-quarter earnings report.

Data & Insights.title: France’s debt crisis explained: Could it trigger another euro zone meltdown?
Data & Insights.summary: France is facing a debt crisis driven by contracting economic activity, rising borrowing risks, and protests that are harming business confidence and public finances. These financial troubles have raised concerns about a potential economic meltdown across the entire euro zone.

Data & Insights.title: 500 GW by 2030: Experts explain why India needs to power up battery storage capacity and grid infra to meet the target
Data & Insights.summary: India must expand its battery storage and modernize its power grid to meet its target of 500 GW of non-fossil fuel capacity by 2030. As of July 31, 2026, the country has installed 300.50 GW of non-fossil fuel capacity.

Data & Insights.title: India’s commerce and industry ministry working to identify AI proof sectors: Piyush Goyal
Data & Insights.summary: India's commerce and industry ministry is working to identify economic sectors that can withstand artificial intelligence-led disruptions. Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal announced this initiative to prepare the country's workforce and industries for technological changes.

Data & Insights.title: Rishikesh–Karnaprayag rail line to have 16 tunnels: How India’s homegrown technology is advancing Himalayan connectivity
Data & Insights.summary: India is advancing Himalayan connectivity by constructing the 125-kilometer Rishikesh–Karnaprayag railway line, which will feature 16 tunnels. This project is driving the expansion of India's domestic tunnel boring machine manufacturing capabilities.

India.title: Delhi Records Month's Lowest Minimum Temperature At 17 Degrees Celsius
India.summary: Delhi recorded its lowest minimum temperature of the month at 17 degrees Celsius. Meanwhile, the maximum temperature reached 31.1 degrees Celsius, which is 0.7 notches below the seasonal average.

India.title: "Very Severe Storm": Red Alert In Odisha Ahead Of Cyclone Arnab
India.summary: Odisha is under a red alert as Cyclone Arnab approaches as a very severe storm. Heavy to very heavy rainfall is forecast for multiple districts, including Kalahandi, Puri, and Khordha, on October 28.

India.title: Storm Over M Kharge's 'Baap' Retort Against PM Modi. Then A 'Misunderstanding' Twist
India.summary: Congress chief Mallikarjun Kharge faced criticism after using a controversial word regarding Prime Minister Narendra Modi during a speech. A heckler named Santosh Kumar was removed from the venue and claimed his remark about a revolt against Modi was misunderstood.

India.title: Delhi Government Schools To Get Medical Rooms With First-Aid Facilities, Dedicated Health Worker
India.summary: Delhi government schools will be equipped with medical rooms and dedicated health workers to provide first-aid facilities. This initiative follows the National Education Policy 2020 to ensure safe and supportive learning environments for students.

India.title: DK Shivakumar's Warning To Bengaluru IT Firms After 'No Jobs For Kannada Speakers' Video Goes Viral
India.summary: Karnataka Deputy Chief Minister DK Shivakumar warned Bengaluru IT firms that the government will take action if they deliberately sideline Kannadigas in hiring. His warning followed a viral video showing a job seeker being denied employment for not knowing Kannada.

India.title: Darjeeling Teen Found Dead On Roof In Assam's Dhubri
India.summary: Anuj, a teenager from Darjeeling working in Assam's Dhubri district, was found dead on a roof. He was part of a group of nine young people employed locally at momo shops and beauty parlours.

General.title: Musk says SpaceX restricted Ukraine's Starlink connection as service restored
General.summary: SpaceX restricted Ukraine's Starlink satellite network because the company accused Ukraine of violating terms of service by using it for military activities. The internet service has since been restored.

General.title: Burnham open to 'honest discussion' on EU free movement
General.summary: Prime Minister Keir Starmer is open to an honest and evidence-based discussion regarding the return of free movement between Britain and Europe. He emphasized the need for a factual and evidence-based debate on the matter.

General.title: Couple were celebrating anniversary before Bahamas tragedy
General.summary: Leanne Gregory from Nottinghamshire died in the Bahamas while trying to save her sons from being swept out to sea. The couple was celebrating their anniversary at the time of the tragedy.

General.title: Voters in Brazil head to polls as Lula goes up against Bolsonaro's son
General.summary: Voters in Brazil are heading to the polls in an election featuring Flávio Bolsonaro, the son of the imprisoned former president. He is challenging Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, who is seeking a fourth term in office.

General.title: More than 1,300 arrested as clashes follow another day of mass protests across France
General.summary: More than 1,300 people were arrested in France following widespread mass protests and violent clashes. Hundreds of thousands of demonstrators participated in these events across France and other European nations.

General.title: Why the charts are full of old songs - and so are your playlists
General.summary: Classic songs are dominating streaming services and music charts. This trend is driven by listeners increasingly streaming older music instead of new releases.
